head: 4f8ff3443a60bf963e826720be67b84b1a6ee8b8

findings.issue: Category membership does not require a JSON array. index_job preserves scalar and object manifest categories, so json_each treats categories="AI" or {"topic":"AI"} as an AI membership in FTS, short-query, semantic and both Ask paths. list_videos instead treats the key of {"AI":"elsewhere"} as a category. Require array metadata in both readers so only actual category string elements can match.

summary: Fixed one medium-severity defect: non-array category metadata could become false memberships, with inconsistent results across Search, Ask and --list. A regression through build_index failed in all six affected paths before the three-line reader fix; full offline checks now pass (637 Python tests and 109 Node controls, with 24 Python skips).
